comments.author: SsmB_92
comments.body_html: Awesome mod, thanks. Now for the obligatory question, when using the AI FDE chassis and 5 round internal mag, in raid it only reloads to 4 and drops a bullet on the ground for some reason. Does anybody know why that is?

comments.author: IceMaverick
comments.body_html:
That’s the default behavior of all integrated-magazine rifles like the Mosin or SKS. Because the magazine is not detachable, there will only ever be 4 rounds inside of it as the 5th round is currently inside the chamber, waiting to be fired.

Opening the chamber enough to add additional ammo will cause the bullet in the chamber to pop out and fall on the ground.

comments.author: SsmB_92
comments.body_html: Ah fair enough. I’d previously only ever used magazines on such guns. Figured it was something like this. Though I wonder why it tries to overfill everytime, BSG not too bright I guess XD
